steps.spokenPrompt: Gently blow your nose into a tissue.
steps.successCriteria: A tissue is held to the nose.

steps.spokenPrompt: Hold the spray bottle upright and shake it a few times.
steps.successCriteria: A small bottle is held upright and moving up and down in the hand.

steps.spokenPrompt: Take the cap off the nozzle.
steps.successCriteria: The cap is pulled off the top of the bottle.

steps.spokenPrompt: Tilt your head forward a little, looking down at your toes.
steps.successCriteria: The head is tilted slightly forward.

steps.spokenPrompt: Put the nozzle just inside one nostril and press once while breathing in gently.
steps.successCriteria: The bottle nozzle is placed at one nostril with a finger pressing the top.
No visual check; the person confirms out loud.

steps.spokenPrompt: Wipe the nozzle and put the cap back on.
steps.successCriteria: The cap is pressed back onto the top of the bottle.
